case_number: 2024 INSC 400; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 5154 OF 2024)
summary: Interim bail during Lok Sabha elections; legality of arrest in money laundering case under challenge; non-appearance to 9 notices balanced against CM status, no convictions, investigation from 2022; election significance as compelling circumstance; power to grant interim bail affirmed under Article 21; bail granted for election campaign; conditions on political activity rejected as breaching fundamental rights.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.19
Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.62(5)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; interim bail granted for duration of Lok Sabha elections.
